why: phase-515 R3. rclrs's `new(logger_name)`, at `Info` with every record, no throttle and no filter; ours takes the `&'a Logger` itself, because `LogParams` borrows it (`rust:LogParams`). A logger name becomes one through `get_logger(name)`.
